title: BRIDGE 07428: Unidentified Flying Objects Sighted in Eastern Caribbean, September 9, 1987
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State cable from the U.S. Embassy in Bridgetown reporting on a multi-witness UAP sighting in the Eastern Caribbean on September 1, 1987.

incidents.summary: Hundreds of witnesses, including embassy employees, reported seeing up to seven objects moving at high speed in changing formations over the southeastern coast near Grantley Adams International Airport.
incidents.quote: REPORTED SEEING UP TO SEVEN OBJECTS MOVING AT HIGH SPEED IN CHANGING FORMATIONS

incidents.summary: A LIAT pilot observed the objects while flying at 8,000 feet and reported they were not man-made.
incidents.quote: A LIAT PILOT REPORTEDLY SAW THE OBJECTS WHILE FLYING HIS AIRCRAFT AT EIGHT THOUSAND FEET
